repo_meta_data.description: jOOX - The Power of jQuery Applied to W3C DOM Like JDBC, DOM is a powerful, yet very verbose low-level API to manipulate XML. The HTML DOM an be manipulated with the popular jQuery product, in JavaScript. Why don't we have jQuery in Java? jOOX is jQuery's XML parts, applied to Java.
